Ticket:
Backup schedules and historical export retrieval

We need to verify our compliance archive settings and automated data backup frequency under our current enterprise tier. Specifically, I tried navigating to the system administration panel, clicked on security settings, and attempted to download a historical data export from last quarter, but the export job keeps failing with a timeout error code. Please let me know what logs you need from our end or if there is an alternate path to pull these archives for our compliance audit.
